annotations.title: Tariff landed cost and price pass-through

description: Work out landed cost per unit for imported goods with stacked duty rates, MPF and HMF, and the selling price that keeps your margin. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version, reference-value notes (official figure or your figure, with source and effective date), a check link and a source-page URL. Official reference values are prefilled when omitted; supply every other figure from the user's records. Percent fields take percent numbers. No figures are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

broker.description: Customs broker and entry fees for this entry (US dollars). Your broker invoice for this entry, including bond and filing charges.

hmfRate.description: Harbor maintenance fee (HMF) rate. Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. Port use fee on the value of commercial cargo unloaded from a vessel at a covered port. Official reference value 0.125% from 19 CFR 24.24 (harbor maintenance fee), effective current eCFR text as of 2026-11-09. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used. Used only when vessel is yes; ignored otherwise.

inland.description: Other landed costs for this entry (US dollars). Drayage, inland freight, warehouse receiving and similar costs to get the goods ready to sell.

lines.description: Import lines on one formal entry. One row per product or HTS line on the entry summary. The first line is shown at the top of the results.

freight.description: International freight and insurance allocated to this line (US dollars). Your share of the ocean or air freight and cargo insurance for this line.

label.description: Line reference label (no names needed). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for line reference label (no names needed). Unknown is not the same as zero. Optional reference label; no names or personal data.

mfn.description: HTS general duty rate. Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. The general (column 1) ad valorem rate for the HTS number, from the USITC Harmonized Tariff Schedule.

other.description: Other additional duty rate. Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. Any other ad valorem duty for this line, such as antidumping or countervailing deposits; enter 0 if none.

price.description: Current selling price per unit (US dollars). The price you charge today for one unit, before sales tax.

priorCost.description: Landed cost per unit before the tariff change (US dollars). Your recorded landed cost per unit for the same item before the new rates.

s232.description: Section 232 additional duty rate. Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. Any Section 232 additional rate that applies to this line; enter 0 if none or if it replaces another rate.

s301.description: Section 301 additional duty rate. Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. Any Section 301 additional rate that applies to this line; enter 0 if none.

units.description: Sellable units on this line (units). Units you will sell from this line, after removing damaged or unsellable units.

value.description: Customs value of this line (US dollars). The entered (transaction) value of the goods on the entry summary or commercial invoice, in dollars.

mpfMax.description: MPF maximum per formal entry (US dollars). Fiscal year 2027 maximum MPF for a formal entry. Official reference value 670.86 USD from CBP, Customs User Fees To Be Adjusted for Inflation in Fiscal Year 2027 (Federal Register 2026-15530), effective 2026-10-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used.

mpfMin.description: MPF minimum per formal entry (US dollars). Fiscal year 2027 minimum MPF for a formal entry. Official reference value 34.58 USD from CBP, Customs User Fees To Be Adjusted for Inflation in Fiscal Year 2027 (Federal Register 2026-15530), effective 2026-10-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used.

mpfRate.description: Merchandise processing fee (MPF) rate. Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. Ad valorem MPF on formal entries, charged on the total customs value of the entry. Official reference value 0.3464% from CBP, Customs User Fees To Be Adjusted for Inflation in Fiscal Year 2027 (Federal Register 2026-15530), effective 2026-10-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used.

vessel.description: Did the goods arrive by commercial vessel at a US port?. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for did the goods arrive by commercial vessel at a us port?. Unknown is not the same as zero. Options: yes = Yes, ocean shipment (harbor maintenance fee applies); no = No, air, truck or rail.

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.

checkURL.description: Link that replays this calculation on https://buscalc.com/sumtru/verify/. Null when the inputs hold free-form text or the link would be too long.

notes.description: Reference-value notes first, then model notes and the standard limit statement.

referenceValues.description: One entry per official reference value in play: the official figure, the figure used, status official or user, source, effective date and the note text.

sealURL.description: Where a saved record of this result can be sealed with an independent timestamp.
